evidence.title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty

summary: A new study proposes a safety‑direction penalty that steers language models away from reasoning paths that lead to misaligned or harmful outputs. Experiments demonstrate that the technique reduces misalignment while preserving overall model performance.
title: Researchers Introduce Safety‑Direction Penalty to Counteract Reasoning‑Induced AI Misalignment
